parrafo.es: Rey's Mobile Car Wash & Detailing limpia a fondo autos, camionetas y motorhomes directo en tu casa, en Homestead y alrededores. Rey llega con el equipo y se queda hasta dejarlo impecable.
parrafo.en: Rey's Mobile Car Wash & Detailing deep cleans cars, trucks and motorhomes right at your home, around Homestead. Rey brings the equipment and stays until it is spotless.

parrafo_1.es: Rey's Mobile Car Wash & Detailing lleva el lavado y el detailing a donde esté tu vehículo: autos, camionetas, motorhomes y hasta deportivos. Rey hace el trabajo él mismo, con calma y sin apurar el resultado.
parrafo_1.en: Rey's Mobile Car Wash & Detailing brings the wash and detailing to wherever your vehicle is: cars, trucks, motorhomes and even sports cars. Rey does the work himself, taking his time to get the result right.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes describen el servicio como meticuloso: Rey explica lo que hace en cada paso y deja el vehículo limpio por dentro y por fuera.
parrafo_2.en: Clients describe the service as meticulous: Rey explains what he is doing at every step and leaves the vehicle clean inside and out.

items.quote: I recently moved from WA state, my car needed some deep cleaning inside and out. I contacted Rey and he was able to service my vehicle in 2 days. He did an amazing job! I highly recommend! Very careful.

Rey did an amazing job cleaning the interior and exterior of my Subaru. He arrived on time and spent half a day meticulously cleaning every inch of my car. I also learned a lot in the process thanks to him.
Great work and very fair price for standard wash, already scheduling for clay at next month! Thanks Rey!
